dim.description: Positive scalar `Tensor` representing each sample's dimension.

num_results.description: Positive scalar `Tensor` of dtype int32. The number of Sobol points to return in the output.

skip.description: (Optional) Positive scalar `Tensor` of dtype int32. The number of initial points of the Sobol sequence to skip. Default value is 0.

dtype.description: (Optional) The `tf.Dtype` of the sample. One of: `tf.float32` or `tf.float64`. Defaults to `tf.float32`.
constraints: dtype must be one of tf.Dtype, tf.float32, tf.float64

output.description: `Tensor` of samples from Sobol sequence with `shape` [num_results, dim].
